title: Restriction along an injection
statement: Let $A$ be a type, let $M,R$ be nonnegative integers, let $e:\{0,\ldots,M-1\}\hookrightarrow\{0,\ldots,R-1\}$ be an injection, and let $x$ assign an element of $A$ to each of the $R$ indices. Under the canonical decomposition of such assignments into values on the image of $e$ and on its complement, the first component at index $i$ is $x(e(i))$ for every $i<M$.
hypotheses_covered: $e$ is an injection from the $M$ indices to the $R$ indices
$x$ assigns an element of $A$ to each of the $R$ indices
